NEOW.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-0.anci: [sine]..The tides.. have brought.. you to me... Daughter of the Sea...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-1.char: A leviathan of the deep... This is neither Kul Tiras nor Azeroth. What manner of prison is this Spire?
NEOW.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-2.anci: [sine]...A cage.. indeed... Take.. my blessing... and shatter.. its.. crown...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.1-0r.anc: [sine]..White hair.. bound in.. arcane and.. salt... Set sail.. once more.. Archmage...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-0.anci: [sine]..Once.. you turned.. away.. from blood and.. ash...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-1.char: Stratholme, Theramore, my father's fleet... I remember them all. The Daughter of the Sea will never run from the storm again.
NEOW.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-2.anci: [sine]...Good... Let.. the cold tide.. drown.. the Spire...[/sine]
DARV.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-0.anci: Whoa! Those arcane runes on your staff — and that anchor crest! Care to trade a relic or two, my lady?
DARV.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-1.char: This staff belonged to my mentor, Archmage Antonidas. It is not for trade. Still, if you hold relics to breach this Spire, I will gladly look.
DARV.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-2.anci: Hah, a principled Archmage! Go on then, take your pick from my hoard!
DARV.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.1-0r.anc: The Lord Admiral returns! Don't worry — my vault rivals anything in Dalaran!
DARV.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-0.anci: Funny thing — years ago I found a sapphire-like arcane prism shard humming with terrifying power...
DARV.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-1.char: Keep it locked away from the ambitious. I have seen a stolen arcane artifact turn an entire city to ash.
DARV.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-2.anci: Oof, sounds heavy... Here, take something a bit safer this time!
NONUPEIPE.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-0: Jaina Proudmoore, Lord Admiral of Kul Tiras, greets you. Word says you bestow fortune upon those who climb.
NONUPEIPE.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-1:
A visitor bearing both noble grace and an Archmage's poise — how rare.
Step closer, Daughter of the Sea, and receive my blessing.
NONUPEIPE.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.1-0: The winds of chance carry you before me again, Lord Admiral. May this gift chart your course home.
NONUPEIPE.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-0:
You built a harbor of peace across distant seas, and raised your staff anew from the ruins.
Fortune favors the unbroken — take of my power.
OROBAS.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-0.an:
A mage from another world!? Where is Azeroth??
Ice magic, fire magic, water friends!! Why is your hair white as snow!?
OROBAS.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-1.ch: It is the mark left by the mana storm that destroyed Theramore. It reminds me how fragile peace is — and why I must fight.
OROBAS.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-2.an: Bad bomb!! Very bad!! Take this right now and cheer up!!
OROBAS.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.1-0r.a: Daughter of the Sea is back!! Next time can you summon a flying Kul Tiran warship for us to see!?
OROBAS.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-0.an:
Why did sailors sing 'Beware, beware the Daughter of the Sea'?
You just want to protect everyone!!
PAEL.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-0.anci: [thinky_dots]Your soul carries an ocean of guilt and ash...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-1.char: I walked away at Stratholme, stood aside as my father fell, and failed to save Theramore... Yet I have faced my ghosts.
PAEL.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-2.anci:
[thinky_dots]Then take a part of me.
May it ease the winter upon your shoulders...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.1-0r.anc: [thinky_dots]You know the scent of dragons... Are the blue guardians of magic in your world just as weary?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-0.anci:
[thinky_dots]Do not seal every sin in ice.
You have paid enough, Daughter of the Sea...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-0.anci: A WOODEN STAFF!? A WARRIOR NEEDS A FIERCER WEAPON!!
TANX.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-1.char: If you had ever watched a Kul Tiran warship raised on frost fire a broadside from the clouds, you would not doubt a mage's weapon.
TANX.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-2.anci: A FLYING WARSHIP!? GLORIOUS!! TAKE THIS AND BLAST THE SUMMIT APART!!
TANX.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.1-0r.anc: SUMMON YOUR BLIZZARDS AND WATER ELEMENTALS, DAUGHTER OF THE SEA! LET US FIGHT!!
TANX.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-0.anci: ARCHMAGE! TEST YOUR METTLE AGAINST ME!!
TANX.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-1.char: [i][font_size=22]Jaina raises her staff, halting Tanx's strike with a surging wall of arcane frost.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-2.anci: MAGNIFICENT!! WORTHY OF A LORD ADMIRAL — CLAIM YOUR PRIZE!!
TEZCATARA.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-0: Oh my, such an icy shell... yet I smell a [jitter][b]searing[/b][/jitter] fury smoldering beneath!
TEZCATARA.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-1: I have watched arcane fire swallow a whole harbor. I command the flame, but I will never become its slave.
TEZCATARA.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-2: A leashed fire is the most [jitter][b]delicious[/b][/jitter] kind! Come warm yourself, Archmage!
TEZCATARA.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.1-0: The embers of Theramore still cling to your fingertips... Come, let your pyroblasts burn [jitter][b]brighter[/b][/jitter]!
TEZCATARA.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-0: Is the Architect still hiding up there? Do go [jitter][b]warm him up[/b][/jitter] with a Flamestrike, won't you?
VAKUU.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-0.anc: Heh... A familiar stench. You have crossed paths with a [sine]Burning Legion[/sine], haven't you, mage?
VAKUU.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-1.cha: From Mount Hyjal to the Broken Shore, I have cast down demons far more arrogant than you. Keep your bargains, Vakuu.
VAKUU.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.0-2.anc: Bold words. Yet we both know mortals always pay a [sine]price[/sine] for power.
VAKUU.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.1-0r.an:
Theramore erased, loved ones lost, branded a traitor by your own kin... Never once tempted by a pact to [sine]burn it all[/sine]?
[i][font_size=22]Vakuu chuckles softly.[/font_size][/i]
VAKUU.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-0.anc: Every city you swore to defend has crumbled in turn. Why struggle on inside this Spire?
VAKUU.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-1.cha: The spirit of Dalaran and Theramore never fell with their stones. So long as I hold this staff, darkness will not prevail.
VAKUU.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.2-2.anc:
[i][font_size=22][sine]Yawn.[/sine][/font_size][/i]
I have heard countless noble vows. Go on — let us see how far yours carry you.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA: Echoes of Dalaran's arcane craft... The Spire has not seen so pure a mage in an age.
I studied in a floating citadel and woke in the ruins of Theramore. Locking worlds inside this Spire makes you just another tyrant obsessed with order.
Tyrant? No. I am its Architect. And you are merely a stray mote drifting across my blueprint.
Frost-bleached hair, haunted by ghosts of the past... You could not even save those you loved. By what right do you challenge my design?
Arthas, Antonidas, my father... Their names are the weight that drives me forward, never a reason to kneel. The Daughter of the Sea faces the storm.
Then freeze here at the summit alongside every memory you carry.
Archmage, the city you founded became a crater; the violet citadel you led fell to ruin. Answer me — what have you ever protected?
I protect the hope that refuses to die — the sails of Kul Tiras, the waking dawn of Azeroth, and every soul that will not yield.
Hollow vows. Let us see whether your arcane tides can crack the Spire's foundation.
